name: Quaternion-Scale Covariance Parameterization
aliases: Covariance Parameterization via Quaternion and Scale
definition: A parameterization of the 3D Gaussian covariance matrix Σ using a quaternion q and a 3D scale vector s to ensure the matrix remains positive semi-definite during optimization.
summary: Quaternion-Scale Covariance Parameterization ensures positive semi-definite covariance matrices by decoupling rotation and scale, avoiding the numerical instability of direct optimization.
